model_implication: Grid import and grid export variables are fixed to zero; supply must come from PV, BESS and hydrogen subsystem, subject to declared unmet-load policy.
validation_note: Consistent with an islanded microgrid study; Trade Street observed net-load data remain an exogenous reconstruction input, not evidence that historic operation was off-grid.

model_implication: Use as first lexicographic objective only inside a reliability-feasible set.
validation_note: Without a reliability hard constraint, minimizing degradation can favor withholding BESS energy and increasing unmet load.
required_follow_up: Declare the reliability hard constraint or explicit allowable unmet-load limit before optimization formulation.

model_implication: Second lexicographic objective after the reliability-feasible and degradation-minimal solution set is established.
validation_note: Requires cost definitions for CAPEX/OPEX, fuel, replacement, curtailment and unmet-load treatment.
required_follow_up: Provide cost scope and financial assumptions when parameter evidence is supplied.

model_implication: Cannot safely remain only a lower-priority soft objective in an off-grid design if priority 1 is battery degradation.
validation_note: Must be elevated to a hard feasibility requirement or bounded metric before lexicographic objectives 1-5 are solved.
required_follow_up: Choose a reliability criterion: zero unserved energy, maximum EENS, maximum LOLP, or critical/noncritical load-service rule.

model_implication: Fourth lexicographic objective after reliability, degradation, cost and residual unmet-load criterion are resolved.
validation_note: Requires PV curtailment feasibility and inverter constraints.

model_implication: In strict off-grid operation, operational grid-electricity emissions are zero; remaining emissions must be explicitly scoped (e.g., hydrogen supply, backup fuel, lifecycle emissions).
validation_note: A carbon objective is undefined until its boundary is stated.
required_follow_up: Declare whether carbon means operational fuel emissions, purchased-hydrogen emissions, lifecycle emissions, or another documented boundary.
